evidence: All 55 criterion descriptions (2 constraints-gate, 1 render-gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) were read in full against the row-33 defect definition (enumerates several requirements, then waives most, leaving the judge two targets). None has that shape. Every binary criterion lists its steps and closes with one explicit 'Fails if ...' disjunction that restates the same legs; the functional and polish prompts add 'A criterion is a conjunction: every step it lists must hold, and each ends with the conditions under which it fails' (scored/functional/prompt.md:15, scored/polish/prompt.md:14), so the bar is one conjunctive target. The carve-outs that exist are narrow scope delimiters, not waivers of the enumerated bar, and each points to the criterion that does score the excluded point: e.g. cw_multi_caret_delete and cw_same_line_carets 'whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere, not here' (the both-modifier demand is in cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic: 'Fails if either modifier-click does not add a caret'); cw_stale_save_keeps_draft 'Whether B shows a conflict message is scored elsewhere' (cw_stale_save_refused); cw_history_restore_adds_revision 'What happens when the same restore request is sent twice is scored elsewhere' (cw_restore_request_repeat_safe); cw_last_good_recovery / cw_time_limit_recovery / cw_stop_cancels_pending_work cross-scope the picture restore and later valid Run. Tolerances are stated once and do not contradict the Fails list: cw_mouse_selection 'One character of pointer imprecision at either end of the drag is not a failure'; cw_js/html_format 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' beside 'characters inside the string ... unchanged'; cw_replace_all_atomic disabled-or-ineffective Redo are two observations of one outcome (replacements do not come back); cw_history_restore_adds_revision 'either refused or added on top' resolves to one observable (fifth revision's source still listed). Arithmetic inside descriptions is consistent (MUL+TI at three carets = 'fifteen inserted characters'; 'those five areas' = editor, Run, preview, console, library; 'five actions' = Format, Undo, Redo, Replace all, Save). cw_js_semantic_coloring states 'One bar:' explicitly. Visual likert anchors are monotone and agree with the prompt's rule that 0 means not shown. Per the skill's known false positive and the internal workbook annotation, whole-flow bundling (e.g. cw_preview_isolation, cw_error_message_and_line) is not a row-33 defect. Runtime: no configured judge run exists for these bytes (index scope), so judge interpretation is not exercised; this row is decidable from the text. NOTES (not blocking): (N1) gates/constraints/judge.toml cw_custom_document_surface: the sentence 'Passes when the source is drawn by ordinary non-editable elements, canvas or SVG' is not qualified by the ready-made-editor markers listed in the preceding Fails sentence; Monaco draws lines in non-editable divs with a small hidden textarea, so both the Pass sentence and the allowance sentence read true while the 'monaco-editor' marker says fail. The explicit Fails list comes first and a careful judge fails it, but adding 'and none of the listed markers is present' would remove the second reading. The same description asks the judge to find 'which element has keyboard focus while typing' but no pass/fail condition uses focus. (N2) polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus enumerates nine control groups and then says 'a control the app has disabled ... is not counted' and 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here'. It remains one bar (every offered, enabled control reachable with visible focus, plus the editor exit), but it is the closest thing to the enumerate-then-waive shape: an app offering few controls is graded on fewer. Stop is normally disabled while idle, so it is usually uncounted. (N3) cw_restore_request_repeat_safe tells the judge to 'note the status of the reply' but the status is not part of the bar; harmless surplus instruction. (N4) cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo / cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo require 'the source must become several lines' in the steps but omit it from the Fails list; the prompt's conjunction rule covers it. (N5) app_context.md:30 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work' sits beside polish cw_narrow_width_usable / cw_controls_feedback_and_labels, which press Run but say 'Whether Run produces the right output is scored elsewhere'; the criteria's own wording is specific enough to govern.
suggested_fix: Optional wording tightening only: in cw_custom_document_surface make the Pass sentence conditional on none of the listed ready-made-editor markers being present and drop or use the focus observation; add 'if the source does not become several lines' to the two Format criteria's Fails lists.
